# SmoothSeas

> SEA-exam preparation platform for primary-school students in Trinidad & Tobago. A child works a
> daily learning loop (lesson → practice → mastery) across a gamified Voyage map; a guardian sees an
> honest progress dashboard. The teaching/scoring engine is deterministic PHP (Laravel 13); AI
> (OpenRouter) is used only at the edges — essay scoring, re-teach chat, OCR — behind budget caps.

This file indexes the canonical docs for LLMs and admins. The engineering wiki lives in `docs/`
(published with MkDocs); the deep product specification lives in `formynieces-spec/`.

- [Architecture overview (C4)](docs/architecture/overview.md): system context, containers, components, key decisions.
- [The learning loop](docs/architecture/learning-loop.md): the core deterministic teaching engine and where AI is used.
- [Data model](docs/architecture/data-model.md): curriculum-as-data, learner-state tables, the cascade hazard.
